name: domain-atlas-directory-demo
description: Reference directory service for SPEC.md §3.3 — crawls submitted manifests on a schedule, indexes every discoverable world, ranks by inbound 'kind: domain' portal count, and answers POST /submit and GET /search. A separate service from either issuer on purpose: a directory indexes OTHER domains, it doesn't issue credentials for its own. Zero dependencies (Node's built-in http/crypto/fetch only) — nothing to npm install.
